description:
Show how many free PayCheck merchant checks the current caller has left for the current UTC day.

Use this before a batch of check_merchant calls, or after an HTTP 402, to read the remaining free allowance and when it resets.

Do not use this to score a payee. It accepts no target and it does not consume a check. Do not pay x402 for this tool. It is always free.

Identity matches check_merchant. Anonymous IP: 100/day. pc_live_ api_key (api_key argument, Authorization: Bearer, or X-API-Key): 1,000/day. Toolweather bundle headers x-tw-bundle-secret and x-tw-bundle-client: hex client 1,000/day, anon: prefix 100/day, any other client id 100/day.

Returns: subject_kind, limit, used, remaining, resets_at (next UTC midnight, ISO-8601), billed (always false), policy_version. No x402 charge.

api_key.description: Optional pc_live_ key. Omit to read the anonymous IP allowance.

name: get_quota
